player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ed say match na GameOfPureStrategy.
- Tinmulang mo so 13 cards A-K; say anggad matakken na saray sanen.
- Say anggad round, say prize card so aralen. Anggapoyan na saray card na may bracketed token aantonen '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Say masanto y card so manalo na prize (plus carry-over). Say ties so iroran na prize ed pot para say sunod round.
- Say masanto y total na anggad 13 rounds so manalo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kaukolan ya eksakton MANGISUNGA ed sakey a paraket so aksion.
invalid_move.card_not_held: Anggapo lay karga na satan a card.
